findings.description: Authenticated producer receipt case_ordinal and case_id are not compared with the replay assignment, allowing cross-case packet substitution.
Per-prefix assignment comparison uses aliased mutable row and indexes values rather than an independently captured immutable assignment snapshot.
Common runtime identity is not compared with the actual runtime before numerical imports; rejection is deferred to the test's registered_case check.
Lease and shard-science cycle comparisons do not enforce exact integer typing, admitting boolean false as cycle zero.
